kind: conceptual five-stage learning roadmap, not experimental data or completion status
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: a Chinese learning-roadmap flowchart embedded at the full width of a GitHub README.
Create one polished flat educational infographic, landscape approximately 4:3, white background, deep navy typography and teal accents, with generous whitespace and crisp Simplified Chinese text. Calm scholarly visual style. Typography must remain readable at about 850 px display width.

Title at top: "五阶段学习路线"
Subtitle: "先跑通整体，再逐项深入"

Layout: FIVE horizontal rounded cards stacked vertically, with numbered circular markers 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 on the left linked by one continuous downward arrow path. Each card has a short bold stage title on the left and two concise lines of details on the right; a subtle thin divider separates title and detail. Add at most one small clean line icon per card. All five cards equal width and similar height. Strong top-to-bottom reading order. Use teal and pale blue consistently, with a subtle pale amber accent only on the last card to suggest future focused work, not a warning.

Render the following exact content:
01 stage title "先看整体效果"
detail line1 "查看成果 · 运行合成港口演示"
detail line2 "区分：找到通路 / 满足靠泊姿态"

02 stage title "弄清地图和搜索"
detail line1 "四叉树 → 邻接与 LOS → A*"
detail line2 "从 S1 动手实验开始"

03 stage title "处理转弯与抵泊"
detail line1 "G2CBS：曲率限制与路径平滑"
detail line2 "RS：起终朝向、前进与倒车"

04 stage title "回到论文条件"
detail line1 "重跑恢复地图算例与方法对照"
detail line2 "核查参数、计时、节点与约束口径"

05 stage title "最后攻克缺口"
detail line1 "短转向合并 · 作者策略对齐"
detail line2 "坐标转换 · 跨图局部重规划"

Constraints: this diagram describes a learning sequence, NOT completion status or empirical findings. No checkmarks, no percentages, no invented experimental numbers, no algorithm performance claims. No source map, no paper screenshot, no repository file trees, no charts. Every Chinese label must be legible, spelled exactly and fully contained. Minimal decorative icons, no 3D effects, no watermarks, no extra footer disclaimer. The image should be more scannable than a paragraph while faithfully retaining all five learning stages.
validation: Visual inspection: five stages, Chinese text, order and arrows checked; no source-paper or private-note images used.
